summary: Verified the batch-partial-payment / stuck-OCR fix: 4 backend test files (6 test functions) added for the 4 acceptance-matrix criteria, all API-only (no UI surface was specified by the matrix, so no browser checks were written).

checks.criterion: Policy with Partial Payment, stuck 'extracted'/not-OCR-blocked, batch amount applied before statement outstanding is read -> outstanding shows premium minus batch amount, not full premium
checks.name: test_extracted_policy_batch_allocated_outstanding_reduced_in_statement (tests/test_tscheck_batch_partial_payment_stale_processing.py)
checks.evidence: Seeded extracted policy gross_premium=51354 + pending upload_batch_payments amount=20000 for a throwaway agent. POST /api/statements (admin) -> 200, outstanding_lines entry outstanding=31354 (51354-20000, not 51354); GET /api/policies/{id} payments sum=20000; upload_batch_payments.status='allocated'. Cleaned up statement/batch/policy/agent.

checks.criterion: Stuck 'processing' policy with a known premium no longer blocks the batch
checks.name: test_stale_stuck_processing_policy_with_known_premium_unblocks_batch (tests/test_tscheck_batch_partial_payment_stale_processing.py)
checks.evidence: Policy status='processing', created_at=now-1h, fields.gross_premium=51354 + pending batch amount=20000. POST /api/statements triggers allocate_stale_batches(agent_id) as a side effect; GET /api/policies/{id} payments sum=20000; upload_batch_payments.status='allocated'.

checks.criterion: Young processing policy (premium still unknown) still waits for OCR
checks.name: test_young_processing_policy_unknown_premium_still_waits (tests/test_tscheck_batch_partial_payment_stale_processing.py)
checks.evidence: Policy status='processing', created_at=now, fields.gross_premium=None + pending batch amount=20000. After POST /api/statements, GET /api/policies/{id} payments==[]; upload_batch_payments.status still 'pending'.

checks.criterion: Single-file partial upload still correct (not disturbed by the batch fix)
checks.name: test_single_file_partial_upload_records_amount_paid (tests/test_tscheck_single_file_partial_upload.py)
checks.evidence: POST /api/policies/upload (admin, agent_id=qaagent f626bcc2-..., payment_mode='Partial Payment', amount_paid=20000, small synthetic PDF) -> 200, payments sum=20000 in the response and on GET /api/policies/{id}. Policy deleted via DELETE /api/policies/{id} (200) afterward.

action_items: note: running the FULL pre-existing backend suite (unrelated to this fix) shows 53 pre-existing failures out of 129 tests (e.g. agt1001/Agent@123 login returns 401 in this preview, several broker-payment-mode / health-endpoint / mis-export tests also fail). These are not caused by this iteration's changes (no app code was touched) and are outside this iteration's acceptance_matrix scope, but are flagged here for visibility — a dedicated pass to reconcile these pre-existing tests with the current preview DB state is recommended.
